lines.text: Earth's field is a bubble the solar wind flows around.
The wind carries the Sun's own field with it. Everything depends on which way that field points.
On the earthward side, Earth's field points north.
Northward Bz: the two fields are parallel.
Parallel fields slide past each other. Nothing opens at the nose.
Southward Bz: at the nose the two fields are exactly antiparallel.
Pressed together, the field cannot stay in two pieces.
It breaks, and rejoins across the join. Two lines went in; two different lines came out.
The bent field straightens and flings the plasma away. That is the energy release.
Each new line now has one foot on Earth and one end loose in the wind. It is open.
Zoom back out, and follow the open lines.
The wind drags the open ends back over the poles and stacks them in the tail.
The tail loads. This is the storing half of the cycle.
Far down the tail, the two stacked lobes are antiparallel too.
It reconnects. One piece leaves down-tail; the rest is fired straight back at Earth.
That injection lights the aurora and feeds the ring current.
The closed line drifts back to the dayside, and the loop starts again.
